question: In which year did Louis Pasteur discover that yeast is responsible for producing alcohol from sugar?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**1857**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Louis Pasteur** was a French biologist, microbiologist, and chemist renowned for his discoveries of the principles of **vaccination, microbial fermentation, and pasteurization**.
 
• In **1857**, Pasteur discovered that **yeast is responsible for the process of fermentation**, where sugar is converted into alcohol.
 
• This discovery was pivotal in the field of **microbiology** and contributed significantly to the understanding of **biological processes**.
 
• Pasteur's work laid the foundation for the development of **industrial microbiology** and the production of various alcoholic beverages.
 
• This discovery also led to the understanding that **microorganisms** play a critical role in various biochemical processes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Louis Pasteur**__

 
 
• **Louis Pasteur** is also well-known for his development of the **pasteurization process**, which involves heating liquids to eliminate harmful microorganisms.
 
• He developed the first **vaccine for rabies**, thus saving countless lives.
 
• Pasteur's work in the field of **germ theory** revolutionized medicine by establishing that many diseases are caused by microorganisms.
